ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels; estimated 15% high-intensity coverage against an 85% low-intensity background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a contiguous low-intensity dark field. Interspersed are high-frequency, non-contiguous circular and annular white-pixel clusters (rosettes) measuring 5-25 pixels in diameter, distributed across the entire visible surface with increased density on the distal lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 135 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 6% of the total horizontal fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern. Pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 4 and 12 pixels. Distinct jagged profile is most pronounced on the inner medial edges of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a generally convex arc from the median notch toward the lateral tips, with the terminal points obscured by irregular, non-organic biological accretion.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated spatial clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel rings (annular scars) concentrated in the lower quadrants and mid-sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified biological colonization (barnacle clusters) present on both distal tips, creating high-relief, irregular geometric protrusions that deviate from the smooth fluke-lobe boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible vertical pixel trajectories (liquid shedding) originating from the trailing edge boundary and extending downward toward the water surface.
